# Alerting and Detection Strategy (ADS) — Rule 100009

## Goal

What adversary behavior this detection is meant to catch. Name the ATT&CK technique(s).

## Categorization

- **ATT&CK technique(s):** `T1112` — Modify Registry
- **Tactic(s) (v20):** Defense Impairment, Persistence
- **Lab rule_id:** `100009`
- **Source Sigma rule:** `rules/sigma/T1112_localaccounttokenfilterpolicy`

## Strategy Abstract

How the detection works, in plain language: which telemetry field(s), what condition, what it keys on.

## Technical Context

```xml
<!-- Rule 100009 - UAC remote restrictions disabled (LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy = 1) -->
<!-- MITRE ATT&CK: T1112 - Modify Registry -->
<!-- Sysmon Event ID 13 - Registry value set -->
<!-- Converted from rules/sigma/T1112_localaccounttokenfilterpolicy.yml with sigma_to_wazuh, then manual fixes (see ADS). -->
<rule id="100009" level="8">
  <if_sid>61615</if_sid>
  <field name="win.eventdata.targetObject" type="pcre2">(?i)LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy$</field>
  <field name="win.eventdata.details" type="pcre2">(?i)\(0x0*1\)$</field>
  <description>T1112: UAC remote restrictions disabled - LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy set to $(win.eventdata.details)</description>
  <mitre>
    <id>T1112</id>
  </mitre>
</rule>
```

## Blind Spots and Assumptions

Where this detection fails or can be evaded.

## False Positives

What benign activity could trigger this, and what the baseline measurement actually showed. Reference the baseline manifest action if an FP was seen.

## Validation

- **Positive test:** which atomic test GUID fires it, and the result (detected Y/N, latency).
- **Converter fidelity (if converted from Sigma):** `wazuh-logtest` output confirms the converted rule matches a crafted event
- **Negative test:** the 5-run baseline FP cost.

## Priority / Response

Suggested alert level and a one-line analyst response.
